Ablation stage is internally consistent with no deterministic findings. Verification summary:

(1) Split and seed consistency: All three scenarios (representation_off, standardize_only, standardize_hflip) share common_split_fingerprint 9afc9ed3…7505 and seed 47, matching the baseline_report and best_configuration. Like-for-like comparison is confirmed.

(2) Ablation design logic: The three scenarios form a coherent isolation chain — (a) unit normalization + no augmentation as the representation baseline, (b) standardize normalization + no augmentation to isolate the normalization effect, (c) standardize + hflip to isolate the augmentation effect on top of standardize. The progression is logically sound.

(3) Result magnitudes: Ablation accuracies (0.874–0.878) sit between the tiny_cnn baseline (0.840) and the agentic ResNet18 result (0.906), consistent with partial representation components contributing to the full pipeline gain. No arithmetic inconsistencies detected.

(4) Macro-F1 vs accuracy divergence in standardize_hflip (accuracy 0.8741 < standardize_only 0.8753, but macro_f1 0.8542 > 0.8404) is plausible: hflip may redistribute errors across classes, slightly reducing overall accuracy while improving minority-class recall. Not a defect.

Advisory observations (non-blocking):
- The best configuration uses augmentations [hflip, rotate180], but the ablation only isolates hflip. A fourth scenario (standardize_hflip_rotate180) would complete the ablation coverage for the selected augmentation set. This is a design-coverage gap, not an error.
- The ablation_report does not explicitly state the model architecture used for the three scenarios. If it is the same ResNet18 as the best configuration, the ablation directly decomposes representation contributions; if a different architecture is used, the results are less directly comparable. Recommend confirming and documenting the model family in the ablation artefact.
- All prior-stage advisory items (OOD AUROC degradation at σ=0.4, per-class weaknesses in cancer-associated stroma and smooth muscle, test coverage gap vs. validation target, prior-art quote verification, llm_model_digest null) carry forward unchanged and remain non-blocking for the ablation stage.
llm_issues: Advisory: Ablation covers only hflip; the best configuration also uses rotate180. A standardize_hflip_rotate180 scenario would complete augmentation ablation coverage.
Advisory: Model architecture for the three ablation scenarios is not explicitly stated in the ablation_report; confirm it matches the ResNet18 best configuration for direct comparability.

Advisory: Prior-stage advisories (OOD AUROC near chance at σ=0.4, per-class weaknesses, test-coverage gap, prior-art quote verification, llm_model_digest null) carry forward unchanged and remain non-blocking.
